title: 2dImReg
description: 2D image registration tool for 3D+time datasets, aligning images on a slice-by-slice basis to a specified base image.

input_file.description: Filename of input 3d+time dataset to process
input_file.title: Input file

base_file.description: Filename of 3d+time dataset for base image (default = current input dataset)
base_file.title: Base file

base.description: Time index for base image (0 <= num) (default: num = 3)
base.title: Base time index

nofine.description: Deactivate fine fit phase of image registration (default: fine fit is active)
nofine.title: No fine fit phase flag

fine_blur.description: FWHM of blurring prior to registration (in pixels) (default: blur = 1.0)
fine_blur.title: Fine fit parameters - Blur

fine_dxy.description: Convergence tolerance for translations (in pixels) (default: dxy = 0.07)
fine_dxy.title: Fine fit parameters - DXY

fine_dphi.description: Convergence tolerance for rotations (in degrees) (default: dphi = 0.21)
fine_dphi.title: Fine fit parameters - DPHI

dprefix.description: Write files containing the registration parameters for each slice in chronological order
dprefix.title: D-prefix

dmm.description: Change dx and dy output format from pixels to mm
dmm.title: DMM flag

rprefix.description: Write files containing the volume RMS error for the original and the registered datasets
rprefix.title: R-prefix

debug.description: Lots of additional output to screen
debug.title: Debug flag
